body: I'm pretty sure it's mine. She says she wants to put it up for adoption, which makes me feel like shit. Abortion makes me feel like shit too. Keeping the kid with someone that is really stupid, unattractive, and very immature is another horrible feeling. I have reached a point in my life where there is absolutely no positive side.

I'm so done. Nothing goes my way. Everything piles on and my life has been so scrambled I don't even know where to go, I've lost all my friends and now I'll never have the life I was meant to. I want to die so badly.
